dct_description_sm: "Sketch map" "R.E.L. Russell, Baltimore, Md, 1931" Hand colored positive photocopy showing Confederate troop positions in red, rivers and woods in green, and roads in brown. Union positions, names of a few commanders, place names, and rairoads are indicated in black. Description derived from published bibliography. LC Civil War maps (2nd ed.), 698 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
